view.name: Split-ticket analysis in progress
view.description: Journey page while the analysis streams: a progress box with spinner, current station and progress bar above the selected connection card.

regions.label: Outlined 'BETTER BAHN' wordmark logo link, nothing else
Dark green panel with spinner, 'Prüfe Würzburg Hbf...' label, linear progress bar and '63% — 5 / 8 Stationen geprüft'
'Wähle deine Verbindung' panel with one selected connection card (times, route, leg with train badges, total price) and a selection-confirmation callout

evidence.note: Spinner icon + determinate linear bar at 63%, with step count of stations checked; labels the current station being checked
White bordered, shadowed card summarizing one train connection: times, duration, price, route, leg detail, totals
Solid blue pill labelling the train number

evidence.quote: ✅ Diese Verbindung ausgewählt - Scroll nach unten für Split-Ticket Analyse
evidence.note: Light-blue callout with left accent border confirming selection; persistent inline notice under the card

patterns.rationale: Heading 'Wähle deine Verbindung' and blue selection ring imply the connection card is a selectable option card, but only one option is shown and it is already selected; could not verify that multiple connections would be offered.

evidence.note: Blue 2px selection outline around the chosen connection card
Progress is a loading/computation bar, not a stage sequence of a journey/order

structure.layout: single-column centered app page: minimal logo header, full-width progress strip, then a white panel containing a selected connection card; most of the viewport empty below

aesthetics.typography: Arial throughout: logo 20px bold uppercase, section heading ~20px bold, connection times ~18px bold blue, body 14px, metadata 12px; progress label italic 20px white
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast scale: 20px bold headings/logo, 18px bold times and price, 14px body, 12px secondary detail; hierarchy carried mostly by weight and blue color

notes: Captured mid-computation: the split-ticket analysis is scanning intermediate stations (5/8) with a spinner + determinate pill bar on a muted DB-adjacent dark green (#4b6058) strip; logo is a rounded outlined box wordmark in the same green. The selected connection uses a nested-box look: outer shadowed white panel, blue 2px selection ring, inner bordered card, and a light-blue left-accent callout with an emoji checkmark. Inline style German UI, prices right-aligned, hairline black divider inside the card.
